_comment: OPC UA servers the collector may connect to, and how to treat each one, identified by the server's own ApplicationUri (read from Server.ServerArray at connect).
source_deadband: whether the per-tag deadband (ExcDev) is applied AT THE SOURCE, as an OPC UA DataChangeFilter with Trigger StatusValue.
It defaults to true for any server not listed here: at 34,700 I/O the source deadband is what keeps unchanged values off the wire (§317).
It must be false for a server that suppresses a status change when the value has not moved past the deadband, because such a server can hide a tag going Bad (§318).

sources.name: dcs-simulator
sources.reason: The simulator runs on asyncua 2.0.1, whose server ANDs the data-change trigger with the deadband test, so a StatusCode change on a value inside the deadband is never sent. Measured: with a source deadband, forcing a tag to BadDeviceFailure produced zero Bad notifications. See collector/deadband_evidence.py and fat/records/stage-06-quality-rules.md.
